validation_scope: Independent offline outcome corpus, compatibility and integration tests; seven equivalent-demand synthetic scheduler repetitions; three partial public live cases. No rich-case live parity claim. 2026-09-11 review: public-provider per-method backoff, refused-method marking, window waits and stranded-attempt recovery added with synthetic and live regression coverage. 2026-09-13: start stops as blocked with a named cause (network_unavailable or identity_unavailable) when the identity reads get no response, writing no lane briefs; failed sends record a URL-free failure category. Synthetic regression coverage; motivated by a live Codex run whose sandbox denied the network to start. 2026-09-13 first-run reliability: unused dRPC configuration cannot block public selection; consent/denial recovery guidance and offline regression coverage; live host outcomes recorded separately in provider_recovery_review. Independent review correction: executed blocked starts retain their existing ledger and provider lock instead of instructing a fresh-directory restart; synthetic coverage checks same-session capture and unchanged identity/deadlines. Same day: pool vaults ranked among the largest holders are excluded as protocol custody in the holders fact; the coordinator may run up to four presets (was two) under the same cutoff and grants; capture and lane-check name a host network denial. Metaplex metadata (v1) for the exact mint is read at start and decoded into a metadata fact; its update authority and verified creators become creator attribution leads when no launch receipt attributes one; a shared launchpad update authority (pump.fun) is named and never attributed, and a Pump curve's recorded creator outranks metadata. Position census: one filtered program-account read per Raydium CLMM or Meteora DLMM pool counts its fixed-layout positions (wire dataSize bound raised to 8192 for DLMM), after the standard samples up to four of the largest are sampled in one atomic batch fitted to the leftover grant (the CLMM NFT holder resolved per lead; position_sample packs leads greedily), pool facts carry an optional position_census (derivation contract 1.4.0 at the time; 1.5.0 since the census read stopped being a bound input, so pool facts recorded at 1.4.0 with a census read or replay with their frozen engine), and a refused, unaffordable or interrupted census is the position_census_unavailable diagnostic; adapters accept the census lead kind and carry a lead's holding gap. A keyed dRPC run has a 160-send ceiling (public 120) so the census fits after the standard stages; CLMM census dependencies are planned from the census slice (ticks and position mint), so a CLMM census costs about 10 plus one per lead. Every Unverified finding in the reading checklist and the report's research-gaps table carries a gap_basis from its coverage row and cited attempts: not or partially attempted (standard work remains, targeted follow-up open, budget or time exhausted, no maintained check), attempted with sources inaccessible or returned nothing (evidenced external limit), or informational on a resolved surface; the coverage table lists next_route. Meteora DLMM bin arrays: versions 0-3 are accepted (the two pinned IDL revisions, ce0e6afe and 576919e3 at 0.12.0, keep the 144-byte Bin's amount_x, amount_y, price and liquidity_supply offsets; the SDK tags version 3 as the limit-order release and reads those fields for every version); live census4 arrays carrying version 2 decoded with 70/70 bin prices matching (1+step/1e4)^id*2^64 and every sampled share within its bin supply, so the offline refresh of that run resolves DLMM principal. LbPair and PositionV2 version bytes keep the documented 0-1 bound; a higher byte or set reserved bytes is now a named gap (pair version, pair reserved bytes, control configuration; position version, expanded, reserved bytes) so a future Meteora bump is attributable; layout-sources repository fields carry a single scheme prefix. Unverified-to-verified pass (2026-09-13, from the Codex STONK and PONS runs): the pool derivation now maps the program's ProgramData read so upgradeability resolves instead of gating every pool as partial; the pool packet is the latest usable read that also carries every lead position or LP account, so a later bare pool re-read cannot erase census positions; a resolved concentrated sample with observed positions is observed (reserves are never inferred there); the creator_history derivation is bound to the wallet subject so a coordinator history preset validates. Receipt sampling probes indexer-listed trades (GeckoTerminal, sells first) before a 25-signature chain listing, six probes for two receipts, because a bot-dominated listing (the STONK CLMM pool: four bot transactions touching the pool without swapping) exhausted the old ten-signature, four-probe window. start and collect derive recommended_presets from the facts (pool_activity when no sale verified, creator_history for attributed keys without a history, programs for unread pool programs), write their request files under recommended-presets/ and print them, so the coordinator runs a derived queue instead of choosing presets under the deadline; rows carry an estimated sends figure and are dropped when the leftover grant cannot pay for them or their preset already ran, focused runs get no queue, and the programs preset reads each upgradeable program's ProgramData metadata slice so upgrade authority resolves (the Codex STONK run spent its presets on a harmful pool re-read, a redundant programs read and a crashing history read). Web capture 1.3.0: the twelve-source cap counts pipeline sources and lane sources separately, and a pool trade feed is filed under sellability as a follow_up route, never as pool discovery. Free cluster sources (2026-09-13, evening): start captures RugCheck's token report for the exact mint (keyless) and the importer derives a rugcheck corroboration fact (publication operation under derivation contract 1.6.0; insider networks with supply shares, top holders cross-checked against the exact largest-holder sample, lockers, creator and authority claims, risks, score) filed under current_concentration as a follow_up route; the linked-wallets rating rule names a network at 10% or more of supply as potential_risk. Probed live on STONK: one transfer network of 3,375 wallets at 41.84% of supply.
dependency: Self-contained Solana standard-library transport/session; public RPC default
engine_version_meaning: Legacy schema-1 collector compatibility field, matching solana_common.ENGINE_VERSION; v2 collector, workflow and reporting have independent versions.
live_rich_case_parity: live end-to-end run with two lanes, a preset, compose and checkpoint completed on the public endpoint on 2026-09-12 (docs/reviews/solana-review-fixes-2026-09-11.md); completed broad delivery still depends on lane time and provider limits per run
